newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece sets 3yr coupon bond at 10.70pct, down 30bps.
newsitem.headline: Greece sets 3yr coupon bond at 10.70pct, down 30bps.

text.p: Greece's finance ministry set the coupon on the 3-year, 100 billion drachma bond to be auctioned on December 27 at 10.70 percent, down 30 basis points on the previous issue, it said in a statement.
It also set the base rate on the seven-year, 200 billion drachma floaters to be auctioned on December 27, at 11.20 percent, down 30 basis points on the previously auctioned FRN.
The spread on the base rate was unchanged at 140 basis points making the first coupon on the seven-year FRN equal to 12.60 percent, it said.
Investors could submit non-competitive bids for sums up to 30 percent of the auctioned amount for the three-year coupon bond and the seven-year FRN.
